item.title: More rain is expected after bad flooding in the Four Corners region led to rescues and evacuations
item.description: Hundreds of people have lost power and have been told to evacuate in the Four Corners area. Emergency crews staged overnight rescues, and roads and bridges remained closed Saturday because of severe flooding in Colorado and New Mexico.

item.title: Former NBA star Malik Beasley negotiating plea deal over gambling charges
item.description: Former NBA player Malik Beasley is negotiating a plea agreement with the Department of Justice after initially pleading not guilty to charges of altering his play in 2024 to benefit sports bettors and ease his debts.

item.title: Pakistan urges Afghanistan to act against militants and denies recruiting Afghan fighters
item.description: Pakistan has urged Afghanistan’s Taliban government to take verifiable action against militants it says operate from Afghan territory, rejecting Kabul’s accusation that Islamabad was shifting blame for its own security failures.

item.title: UK police says letter with claims against Meghan's father was not shared with other law enforcement
item.description: British police confirm they passed a letter about alleged offenses by Meghan Markle's father to her in 2019. Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, says she's "deeply distressed" by allegations that child sexual abuse images were found at her father Thomas Markle Sr.'
